name: jobs-local
description: The jobs@1 provider `local-registry`: START a background command on the workbench host, keep a stable job id and a durable log on disk, read the log with a CURSOR (never a re-read), stop the whole process GROUP, clean up finished jobs - and stop every job it owns when the plugin unloads. Declares execution/policies because it starts host processes.

config.description: Where job logs live, how many jobs are kept, the log ceiling and the default stop behaviour.

maxJobs.description: Maximum number of jobs kept at once; a start beyond it fails with reason jobs.limit.

maxLogBytes.description: Byte ceiling of ONE job log; reaching it STOPS the job.

timeoutMs.description: Default job deadline in ms (0 = none; a job is stopped explicitly).

graceMs.description: Grace between SIGTERM and SIGKILL when stopping a job.

allowShell.description: Whether `shell: true` is allowed for a job command.

pageBytes.description: Default byte window of one `logs` page (hard max 1048576).

stopOnUnload.description: Stop every running job (and remove its log file) when the plugin unloads.
